pages.text: Ogre Outposts are the clearest beginning. Their captains guard tribute and clues leading farther into tribal territory.$(br2)A Plains Outpost provides a Fort Map. A travelling Ogre Merchant also carries one. Follow either route when you are ready to challenge the Tribe's royal seat.

pages.title: Follow the Trail
pages.text: The route is simple on parchment. The occupants make it less so.
